_comment: Fixed MR-1 test vectors (T1.5). Every value is hex-encoded. s_scalar, c_scalar, e_scalar are throwaway scalars for testing only, never used outside this file. Consumed by mrcore's Go tests and intended for the Android/Kotlin instrumented tests (WP5) to verify an independent implementation against the same numbers. Scalar and point key names deliberately differ in more than case (Go's JSON decoder folds "e"/"E" together and the later key silently wins, so this file never puts a scalar and its point under keys that differ only in case).

enrol._comment: c_scalar is the enrolment-time ephemeral scalar; C = c_scalar.G is stored in the token; K = c_scalar.S is the shared point used to derive k

recover._comment: e_scalar is the recovery-time ephemeral scalar; X = C + E is sent to the key holder; Y = s_scalar.X is what a full-point key holder (file backend, Tang) returns; xOnly = x(Y) is what an x-only key holder (Android Keystore, TPM2 ECDH) returns instead
